The paper also analyses the complexity and security metrics for the UDBAC model in comparison with RBAC model, and shows that UDBAC model is more secure, less complex and can be easily incorporated in an access control policy. Based on the security analysis, this paper also analyses the confidentiality, integrity and availability impacts on the UDBAC model in health information system if any vulnerability enters into the system.

articleTitle: A Survey on Neural Network Algorithms for Designing Efficient Predictive Models
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Machine learning is a branch of counterfeit consciousness in which the framework is made to gain from information which can be utilized to make expectations, certifiable recreations, design acknowledgments and arrangements of the information. Among the different machine learning approaches in the sub field of information arrangement, neural organize techniques have been observed to be a helpful other options to the measurable systems. A fake neural organize is a scientific model, motivated by natural neural systems, are used for displaying complex connections among sources of info and yields or to discover designs in information. In this paper, we are expounding Fake Neural System or ANN, its different qualities and business applications. In this paper we likewise demonstrate that ”what are neural systems” and ”Why they are so imperative in the present Manmade brainpower” In light of the fact that various advances have been made in creating Astute framework, a few roused by organic neural systems. articleTitle: A Quick Video Searching Approach from a Continuous Stream using Audio Fingerprint
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Audio Fingerprinting technologies have attracted significant attention since they allow the identification of the audio independently of its format and without the need of metadata or watermark embedding. In this paper, we survey and evaluate popular audio fingerprinting systems. Then we propose a new mechanism for using audio fingerprint for searching a particular video or a part of the video.

articleTitle: Image Resolution Enhancement using Discrete Curvelet Transform and Discrete Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Image resolution is an essential parameter to enhance the quality of an image. Even though, many techniques are used to enhance image resolution, multiscale transforms are more effective due to its efficiency in reconstruction of images. Curvelet transform is a multiscale directional transform with the property to deal with the discontinuity along with the curves i.e. edges. Proposed method is based on discrete curvelet transform (DCT) with wrapping methodology and interpolated high frequency sub bands of discrete wavelet transform (DWT). On the low resolution input image, DCT is applied and obtained coefficients are interpolated. Simultaneously, DWT along with interpolation has been applied on low resolution image and evaluated coefficients of DWT are improved by stationary wavelet transform (SWT). Further, Interpolated coefficients of DCT are added with interpolated evaluated coefficients of DWT and SWT. Then, inverse DWT is executed on the added coefficients to gain high resolution image. Thus, accessed parameter values of the image quality and visual representation gives a remarkable result of the introduced work compared to the other traditional wavelet transform and spatial domain interpolation.

articleTitle: Medical Image Segmentation via Optimized K-Means
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: The main purpose of this paper is to identify the suitable algorithm for image segmentation. Medical images have made a great impact on medicine, diagnosis, and treatment. The most important part of image processing is image segmentation. Many image segmentation methods by various researches for medical image segmentation have been presented in this paper. In the course of the comparative analysis, it is evidently demonstrated that the traditional k-means is not appropriate for segmenting the medical images. But K-means gives the best results for image segmentation with smaller number of K - values. Accordingly K-means can be mixtured with snake optimization method and Normalized Cut algorithm and the proposed algorithm is labeled as optimized K-means.

Author Keywords: Snake optimization method and Normalized Cut algorithm

articleTitle: Enhancement of Voltage Quality in Power System through Series Compensation using DVR
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Voltage sag & swell creates useless dispute at the customer side as well as utility side. This paper present, dynamic voltage restorer device is custom power device is used to mitigate voltage sag & voltage swell. Dynamic Voltage Restorer (DVR) is a custom power device that is utilized to compensate the unbalance voltage i.e. to compensate the power quality problems in electrical power system. Usually DVR is installed between load feeder and point of common coupling in the network. In this paper approach to mitigate voltage sagas well as voltage swell by using dynamic voltage restorer base on sine vector template generation is discussed. Simulation is done with the use of MATLAB software and results are obtained.

articleTitle: A Parallel RLE Entropy Coding Technique for DICOM Images on GPGPU
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: the Electronic Healthcare Record (EHR) is the patient's health care data history, which retains the information about the diseases and their DICOM images reports. This application widely used in the medical field and thereby an employing a Iossless entropy coding technique adaptively to remove the redundancy of an image at a precise level. Run-Length Encoding (RLE) is the basic entropy coding method to adopt in the DICOM images. To accelerate the entropy coding process deployed the parallel architecture CUDA with the GPU technology. The parallelized RLE entropy coding technique implemented on GPGPU platform by using the parallelized CUDA programming. Here we proposed a parallel RLE entropy coding technique to accelerate up to 5X times faster than the serial RLE and 2. 25X times faster than parallel Huffman coding. The parallel RLE runs at O(log N) only.

articleTitle: Billing Automation for Supermarkets
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: With increasing access to supermarkets, the human resource required to maintain short queue times is ever increasing. This creates a need for automation in the billing system. A fast and simple solution is to decentralize the billing process. This project mainly aims at reducing queue times by scanning the items when being added to the cart by the customer, than being individually scanned at the billing counter. This is realized using Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) technology. Once the products are scanned using RFID reader and the bill is to be generated, the scanned RFID card numbers are wirelessly transmitted to the billing server/counter using Wi- Fi module. At the billing counter the scanned RFID card numbers are matched against a database and corresponding information such as the product name and product cost are retrieved. Once retrieved, the corresponding product costs are summed, the bill amount could be paid for using digital payment services. Once the payment has been processed, the customer receives an OTP that is to be used at checkout.

articleTitle: Electronic Nose for Identification of Fresh or Spoiled Vegetarian and Non-Vegetarian Food Items With an Android Application
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: The electronic nose was developed in order to mimic human olfaction that functions as a non-reparative mechanism. Essentially the instrument consists of head space sampling, sensor array, and pattern recognition modules, to generate signal pattern that are used for characterizing odors. We have integrated an android application into our project because we believe Enose will give wonders in the field of food industrial management and personal health management. Since Android application is one important factor in this project. Users will be directly dealing with the Android application. It depicts user all the details of the product that kept for sampling. With this the users get benefits such as choosing the food which is good for health.

articleTitle: Solid Modelling Interaction with Sensors in Virtual Environment for the Application of Virtual Reality Welding
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: The imperative part of strong displaying in virtual reality framework is to improve the movement of a user with definitive movement control in genuine intelligent condition. In an ongoing intelligent recreation movement development depends on sensors and other movement control gadgets, yet in virtual condition movement developments depends on the basics of kinematics and energy. Virtual reality interface is utilized to achieve idealize physical communication amongst genuine and virtual recreation with proper dynamic requirements. Aside from info and yield gadgets, few of virtual reality programming projects which oversees different sensors and movement controllers, sensors approaching information lastly produces reasonable yield to an end user. This research paper focusses on movement displaying for connection between CAD models and Virtual Reality Models using 3ds Max 2017 and Unity 3d softwares. The paper likewise portrays different equipment arrangement of sensors and Arduino for virtual reality welding.

articleTitle: Study of Power Quality Issues in Wind Distributed Generation System
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: This paper presents impact of power quality in the presence of grid disturbances and wind system penetration using Distribution Static Compensator (DSTATCOM) and Dynamic Voltage Restorer (DVR). An IEEE 13 bus distribution test feeder with DSTATCOM, DVR and doubly fed wind generator (DFIG) is used for the study. Power quality events during grid disturbances such as voltage sag/ swell and harmonics have been studied in association with DSTATCOM and DVR. The power quality disturbances due to wind generator outage have been investigated. The study has been carried out using MATLAB/SIMULINK 2014a environment.The proposed method has been proved to be effective in improvement of power quality with Wind penetration to the system.

articleTitle: Mitigation of Lower Order Harmonics in a Grid-Connected Single-Phase PV Inverter using Shunt Active Filter
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a novel technique is proposed for mitigating lower order harmonics for single phase PV inverter using active power filter with adaptive harmonic compensation. Step up transformer is used boost the voltage as per requirement of the grid. However, the implemented system will not introduce any lower order harmonics in the grid, but there are little chances of lower order harmonics, because of the dead time of inverter, core saturation and magnetizing current of the transformer, etc. In this paper, a unique approach is being presented which mitigates lower order harmonics using inverter current control. In this paper, adaptive harmonic compensation technique with additional active filter is being presented before feeding a supply to the grid. To obtain better control proportional resonant integral (PRI) controller is integrated. The advantage of using PRI controller is; it eliminates DC component from the control loop. In this paper, a PRI controller and LMS adaptive harmonic filter are also been discussed in great detail. In this paper, two systems are considered and compared one with an adaptive harmonic filter using SPWM, and in the second system, active filter is added before feeding inverter output to the step up transformer. Hence the first system is explained in great detail and for second system illustration of the active filter and obtained results are compared.

articleTitle: The Identification for Participants of Computer Networks by Modified Clustering Method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: The analysis of the network participants is carried out on the basis of graph models and allows defining the associated groups. For find groups in networks, the clustering methods in graph models are widely used: method of centrality, k-means, modularity, hierarchical, spectral, and partitioning around medoids. In such methods of clustering, the results essentially depend on the selected metric. We proposed modifications to the clustering method based on the generalized centrality metric, which takes into account many properties of network participants. In the proposed generalized metric, we applied properties for the centrality. For analyze the accuracy of the proposed method, we considered a group of network participants, which consists of three hundred participants. Comparison of the results of clustering by the proposed method on the basis of a generalized metric shows the accuracy in the definition of groups of network participants similar to those of methods: spectral, k-means, modularity and superior in accuracy methods: centrality, hierarchical.

articleTitle: Recommendation System using Clustering Method based on Item Category and Weight
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: The recent growth of the Internet and increase in web services, it is difficult as well as time consuming to search for the appropriate information that one needs.Recommender systems have become increasingly popular in recent years, and are utilized in a variety of areas including movies, music, news, books, research articles, search queries, social tags, and products in general. This paper proposes a new and efficient way for recommendation system using clustering method based on item category and weight. The method proposed in this paper focuses on clustering method along with the RFM score of the product.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Foliar Diseases using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Image processing in the field of agriculture proves to be an innovative and emergent technology, which leads to incorporating the advanced techniques to enrich the farm input and output in a profitable and environment sensible manner. Present study has been intended to focus on various methods that use digital image processing technique to identify, quantify and classify foliar diseases of various crop plants. The existing issues related to leaf diseases that occurred on various crop plants have been assessed and reported. Based on the existing literature a sequential generalized process has been suggested for foliar disease. A comparison has also been drawn based on the visual analysis and image processing.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of a Low Power and High Speed Carry Select Adder
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: In microprocessors, digital signal processors, various kinds of arithmetic building blocks such as adder/substractor, multiplier/divider, shifter are required to compute binary data. The priority of datapath can be operation speed, low power consumption, area or design time. The most important design goals in many cases are high operation speed and low power consumption. The basic structure in any arithmetic block is an adder circuit. Hence, by optimising the adder circuit, high oparation speed and low power consumption can be achieved. Several kinds of adders have been proposed to reduce the worst-case propagation delay from Least significant bit(LSB) to Most significant bit(MSB). The Carry select adder is one of the adder architectures that reduces the carry propagation delay by grouping sub-block of adders. Many techiques can be used to improve the CSA performance as proposed by researchers in previous work that is, by using BEC-1(Binary to eccess-1 converter), using D-Latch etc. In this work, the CSA is designed using GDI(Gate diffusion input) technique and using both GDI and MTCMOS D-Latch to achieve better performance as compared to previous work. Mentor Graphics 130nm CMOS Technology is used for simulation. The design of CSA using Both GDI and MTCMOS logic achieved a tremendous improvement in operation speed, power consumption and Transistor count of 92.7%, 99.45% and 58.85% respectivelly as compared to the conventional CSA.

articleTitle: Video Quality Assessment Metrics for Infrared Video Frames using Different Edge Detection Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Infrared signal processing algorithms and architectures are important for the development of a high performance infrared imaging systems. Infrared signal processing deals with two types of processing sensor signal processing and infrared image processing for contrast enhancement and target detection. The sensor signal processing primarily deals with non uniformity correction for infrared sensors. Assessing the quality of the Infrared video frame is a complex and firm process since human's opinion is affected by physical and psychological parameters. Infrared Video frame quality assessment plays an important role in the field of video processing. Structural Similarity Index has become a standard among image quality metrics. It is a framework for quality assessment based on the degradation of structural information of video frame. In this paper SSIM values are computed and compared for Infrared video frames by applying different edge detection approaches by using different color models to assess the quality of the frames. Experimental results comparisons demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: An Approach of Abnormality Detection for Diabetic Retinopathy using ANN SVM
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Glaucoma is the diagnosis given to a group of ocular conditions that contribute to the loss of retinal nerve fibers with a corresponding loss of vision. Glaucoma is the major cause of blindness in people above the age of 40. The Intra Ocular Pressure (IOP) increases because of the malfunction of the drainage structure of the eyes leading to Glaucoma. In this paper three methods-Gray Level Difference Method using ANN classifier, Stochastic watershed method using SVM classifier and Pearson R Correlation Method are proposed, which automatically detect Glaucoma disease in the human eye from the fundus database images. The three strategies utilized for retinal abnormality identification are looked at in light of the execution measurements- exactness and blunder rate. The SVM classifier gives more precise outcomes contrasted with other two procedures.

articleTitle: Regression and Artificial Neural Network based Improved Classification of LISS-III Satellite Image
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Remote sensing is one of the very important parts in the advance image processing which is used to acquiring satellite image to know about geo-spatial information. Remote sensing is widely used to monitor different resources available on earth surface, out of which the land used area monitoring is one of very important part. There are many techniques and methods are proposed for satellite image classification based on different theme. Here, in this paper theme of classification is land used and land area cover mapping using LISS-III satellite image. LISS-III satellite image have been classified in different area covered by water, forest, mangroves and developments by selecting the pixel based classification. Here multiple linear regressions is used on initial training data set, after evaluation the new features data set is applied to artificial neural network to check the impact of best training data set on the classification accuracy. The accuracy of classification algorithm is calculated using confusion matrix and Kappa coefficient. It is observed with help of confusion matrix and Kappa coefficient that the accuracy of ANN classifier without evaluated training data set is 90.19% and Kappa Coefficient is 0.8533 and when training data set evaluated with the help of multiple Linear regression then ANN accuracy is 98.74% and the Kappa Coefficient is 0.9766 which is improved and very good. So with the proposed method classification accuracy of ANN classifier is improvement for classification of LISS-III satellite image.

articleTitle: Augmentation of Things
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Augmented reality and Internet of things are two emerging technologies. The Intersection of both would be an engrossing area. If the visual and location based features of augmented reality is combined with real objects which could be operated via internet of things the impact would be great in enhancing user experience. Our research Augmentation of Things aims in integrating the visual impact of augmented reality with the actionable information from Internet of Things providing a location enabled smart system which will create an unparalleled experience for the user.

articleTitle: An Efficient Resource Scheduling Algorithm using Dynamic Priority in Grid Computing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Grid Computing is a dynamic, heterogeneous environment. Scheduling is the heart of Grid computing. There are two Basic categories of scheduling in Grid: Resource Scheduling and Job Scheduling. Resources can be selected as per user demand and on the basis of specific scheduling algorithm. User can submit their jobs in Grid and these jobs are allocated to the resources according to the selected algorithm. In Priority based Scheduling algorithm, Priority of jobs are basic concern. In this paper we provide the flexibility in priority of jobs in specific condition. So the Utilization of resources is high as in some specific situation lowest priority jobs can be allocated before to higher priority jobs to available resources without waiting its priority order. Because of this flexibility, proposed algorithm dramatically reduces the processing cost.

articleTitle: Efficient Speckle Reduction Techniques in Ultrasound Video Quality Enhancement – A Comparative Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Amongst many imaging modalities available now a days, Ultrasound is the most widely used because of the reasons like radiation free, real time, non-invasive and non-ionizing. During patient's care, medical images, videos & other physiological signals, become an integral part of diagnostic and treatment phases. Ultrasound is more advantageous and cheaper than other modalities like MRI, CT, PET. Speckle noise present in US hampers the quality of images which in turn considerably increases the difficulty in medical visual inspection. The diagnostic accuracy will be more if image is less noisy, this necessitates the use of efficient despeckling filter which will take care of edge detection, loss of information and improve visual evaluation. MSE assess the image quality, if the value is high then image quality is poor. PSNR is another quality metrics, high value indicates the better denoising algorithm. In the present work seven different filters are listed and experimental work is carried out on LEE and Hybrid Median filter (HMF). The experimental result of PSNR and MSE values are considered for evaluation purpose.

articleTitle: Interactive Water Bottle Application on a Smart Phone to Enhance User Water Consumption
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: The project, Smart Bottle, is a water bottle that provides the user with real-time data of water consumption through an android application. The user inputs details such as age, weight and gender while registering with the Smart Bottle. The android application features a bar-chart for displaying daily and weekly water in-take, a real-time bottle water indicator, alarm and alert feature for reminding the user to drink water according to the user's water in-take habits and an intelligent system to predict the required water consumption for the present atmospheric temperature and humidity. Seamless Bluetooth connects the Bottle with smartphone.

articleTitle: Low Power VLSI Design for Power and Area Effective Utilisation of Carry Select Adder
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Design of power-efficient and high-speed data path logic systems are one of the most substantial areas of research in VLSI system design. In digital adders, the speed of addition is limited by the time required to propagate a carry through the adder. The sum for each bit position in an elementary adder is generated sequentially only after the previous bit position has been summed and a carry propagated into the next position. The CSLA is used in many computational systems to alleviate the problem of carry propagation delay by independently generating multiple carries and then select a carry to generate the sum. However, the CSLA is not area efficient because it uses multiple pairs of Ripple Carry Adders (RCA) to generate partial sum and carry by considering carry input, then the final sum and carry are selected by the multiplexers (mux). The existing modified SQRT CSLA is to use Binary to Excess-I Converter (BEC) instead of RCA with Cin=1 in the regular CSLA to achieve lower area and power consumption with slightly increase in the delay. The basic idea of this work is to use Common Boolean logic(CBL) instead of BEC in the regular CSLA to achieve high speed and low power consumption ane even the area consumed by the each system.

articleTitle: Performance Issues of Routing Protocols in Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: MANET (Mobile Ad hoc Network) is a self-constituting network of mobile nodes connected by wireless links. Hosts rely on each other to keep the network connected. It represent complex distributed systems that comprise wireless mobile nodes that can freely and dynamically self-organize into arbitrary and temporary, ad-hoc network topologies, allowing people and devices to seamlessly internetwork in areas with no pre-existing communication infrastructure. This paper presents a comprehensive study on performance issues of routing protocols in wireless networks.

articleTitle: Secure Perceptual Hashing of Data using Encryption
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Orthogonal A perceptual image hash function maps an image to a short binary string based on an images appearance to human eye. This paper proposes a theoretical analysis of full perceptual hashing systems that use a quantization module followed by a crypto-compression module. Finally, several experiments are conducted to validate the approach, by Gaussian noise and JPEG compression. Finally the image is encrypted using secret key called SHA-1 (Secure Hash Alogorithm-1) of 128 bits.

articleTitle: Feature based Encryption for Data Privacy and Access Control for Medical application
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: The healthcare organization collects large complex healthcare data that are not mined to uncover the hidden information for valid decision making. Discovery of hidden relationships and patterns often goes unexploited. Advanced data mining techniques can be a remedy this situation. Personal Health records have raised as a patient centric healthcare services where the patients health information is accumulated on the cloud. It gives an opportunity for the individuals to create, manage and distribute the data on the cloud. But this involves considering the issues of security and privacy. With technological development cloud services are being used widely and comprises of multiple users and owners of this cloud service, thus results in data management complexity. The objective of the paper is to predict Chronic Kidney Disease(CKD) using classification techniques and emphasize on the consequences of security and data access control of patient health information in the real time application. To manage huge amount of data, a flexible and fine-grained access control solution should be used. A favorable approach has emerged based on Feature Based Encryption, which provides flexible and fine-grained access control. Complexity of key management can be reduced by distributing users into multiple domains. But keys and data on clouds can be intercepted by semi trusted servers. Therefore Advanced Encryption Standard is used for providing high security of data.

articleTitle: MELP Decoder Implementation on Zynq Kit by High Level Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: MELP (Mixed Excitation Linear Prediction) is the improvement of LPC (Linear Predictive Coding). This is to overcome some of the limitations of LPC. It is one of speech compression and decompression algorithm. The Federal standard MELP speech coder is known to provide a good quality decoded speech. The MELP Vocoder decoding part is implemented on ZYNQ-7 ZC706 using Vivado HLS and synthesized the same using the Vivado. The results of Vivado HLS and Vivado are compared.

articleTitle: Survey on Improvement of PVT aware Variations in Tunnel FET on SRAM Cells
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: TFET-Tunnel Field Effect transistors is an upcoming transistor. MOSFET (Metal Oxide Semiconductor Field Effect Transistors) is generally used for low Power applications in electronics devices. The structure of TFET is approximately very closer to MOSFET, however with different fundamental switching mechanism. The Switching activity of T-FET is based on the mechanism of modulating quantum tunneling through a barrier instead of modulating thermionic emission over a barrier as in traditional MOSFETs, there are different types of SRAM cells using the TFETs this paper is a survey of work done on various models and a proposal of INDEP method for improving the power, voltage and temperature variations using the tunnel FET on 6T SRAM cells.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of CWSSIM Video Quality Metric with Different Window Size on LIVE Database
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a method to evaluate the performance of Complex Wavelet Structural Similarity Index Measure(CWSSIM) for different levels of steerable pyramid. There are two methods in the evaluation of quality of video. One being subjective quality assessment and other being objective quality assessment. Here, we are performing objective quality analysis. Objective quality analysis aims to provide an independent measure of quality of video irrespective of subjects and having correlation with perceptual quality. In our approach, we are performing full reference video quality analysis using LIVE database and analyzing through regression analysis.

articleTitle: Proposing a Delphi-Study as Non-Biased Alternative to Studies and Roadmaps Predicting the Future of Robotics, Automation A.I.
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Currently, a multitude of studies, whitepapers and roadmaps claim to predict the future of robotics and automation. Unfortunately, all of them are to some extent limited in their scope, by design and/or are biased by some particular interests. In most cases this is not even by intention, but the fact, that the euRobotics Multiannual Roadmap and Strategic Research Agenda only focus on the European robotics community limits it to a certain field of view. The same applies for the U.S. Robotics Roadmap and other documents. In this paper, we suggest the methodology for a Delphi-Study - a guided, unbiased and holistic approach based on neutral interviews with internationally well renowned experts. The necessity for a Delphi-Study has already been laid out by the IEEE RAS Industries Activities Board in the IEEE RAM Magazine [6].

articleTitle: Wi-Fi Strength Measurement and its Analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: The project is all about measurement of Wi-Fi signal strength in our college campus. For this we have selected the WLAN named VIT_CAMPUS. We analysed that there are some places in campus where signal is too weak and somewhere dead zones are identified. After that we analysed the router positions and effective distance of transmission of signal from router. For this we had a brief search about the tools available for measuring the signal strength. From those we picked one tool for our study named Wi-Fi analyser by Kweulsoft. Then we measured the signal strength at various positions, floors and rooms in our campus. Then we studied the data, router positions and concluded to a solution.

articleTitle: Classification of Liver Tumor using Modified SFTAbased Multi Class Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Liver tumor is one of the most common diseases and it increase the mortality rate. So detection at its early stage is very important and this is done through different non-invasive imaging techniques such as US scan, MRI, CT, PET etc. In this work CT images are used for the detection and classification of liver tumor. The CT imaging is compatible with MRI in respect of image quality and economy. For the classification of liver tumor, the CT image is segmented first for obtaining the boundaries of liver and liver tumor in it. Segmentation of liver and its tumor is done using adaptive threshold method. A modified SFTA algorithm is used to extract the features from tumor and these features are used for tumor classification. In this work SVM is used as classifiers. The performance analysis is taken between SFTA based multi SVM classifier and modified SFTA based multi SVM classifier. The results show that modified SFTA based SVM classifier provides accurate results of 94.531% over SFTA based multi SVM classifier.

articleTitle: Stock Indices Forecasting based on Wavelet Filters and Improved Instance based Learning (WIIBL)
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: The proposed model implements a unique technique that extends the nearest neighbor rule to incorporate the idea of pattern matching to identify similar instances thereby implementing a non-parametric regression approach. A hybrid distance measure combining statistical correlation and Euclidean distance has been incorporated in the model to select similar instances. To illustrate the performance and effectiveness of the proposed model, simulations using data sets of CBOE S&P Buy Write Index, 95-110 Collar Index and Gold Volatility Index has been carried out. Here, we apply a comprehensive set of non-redundant orthogonal wavelet transforms for individual wavelet sub band to denoise the signal. A thorough analysis of model simulations demonstrate that the proposed wavelet based-IIBL model ends up in accurate predictions and encouraging results.

articleTitle: Parallel Analytical Model for Frequent Itemset Mining
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: The data generated in real world applications in recent days are quite huge and processing and analyzing those data has become a challenging task. For any analytical and inference engine finding frequent itemsets turns out to be a major functionality. Frequent itemset mining is performed usually with the help of association rule mining technique in data mining. Generally the results obtain from these techniques are large and diverse which makes it difficult for an inference engine to reach a conclusion. One of the ideal solutions for handling such datasets is by devising a parallel processing system to efficiently run the data mining approaches and obtain a more accurate and easily analyzable output. The research carried out here aims at designing and developing parallel analytical model for frequent itemset mining in big data by integrating R on Hadoop.

articleTitle: Computation of Spread of Tweets on Twitter
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Twitter is observed to be a very strong platform to reach more audience. The thoughts that are shared on twitter can have positive as well as negative impact. In this paper our focus is to find and provide some metrics to evaluate the spread of any tweet. This can be considered as the first step towards identifying the impact of any tweet. We assume that we have appropriate API's or web services to get required information regarding the tweet. We have taken some real time tweet to find the spread. In this work, the speed of spread is also captured. The speed aspect of a spread is found useful in further analysis of certain tweets under investigation.

publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract:
