This paper presents the review of various torque ripple reduction techniques, various reasons behind the production of torque ripple in a three phase star connected brushless DC motor with trapezoidal type back emf. Unlike the PMSM whichrequires sinusoidal excitation, the PMBLDC motor requires quasi square wave stator currents to produce constant torque. The torque ripple produced in the PMBLDC motor affects the drive performance where accuracy is of utmost importance. Here a comprehensive study of various methods which reduces the torque ripple in commutation as well as during conduction period is provided.

articleTitle: Inertial Sensor Based Localization Using Wi-Fi In Complex Indoor Environment
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: The recent years has seen a lot of research in indoor Iocalization and location services. Wireless location finding is one of the key technologies for wireless sensor networks. The GPS technology used for outdoor Iocalization, but when to deal with indoor Iocalization GPS solution is inadequate. Indoor locations include buildings like supermarkets, big malls, parking, universities and locations under the same roof. Though indoor location services based on received signal strength indication (RSSI), fingerprinting, angle of arrival (AoA) and time of flight (ToF) based techniques attracted more attention from Researcher, there is very less work has been done in achieving accuracy, removing NLOS errors and providing indoor navigation system. The proposed system which works on improving positioning accuracy of Iocalization and increasing speed of positioning with NLOS Error and TOF Ranging Error Mitigation using Wi-Fi RSSI based Fingerprinting and use of inertial sensors of smartphone like Accelerometer, magnetometer and Gyroscope. Furthermore an advanced particle filter is used to mitigate ranging error and NLOS Error.

articleTitle: Non–Cognitive Factors Should be More Focussed in K-12 Education: A thorough Study
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: The study of this paper of ours is focused on assessing the K-12 students since this is the major portion of student's life and whatever they are going through during this tenure stays in their memories and plays a vital role in their life. Here, we have tried to elaborate how and what impact the non-cognitive factors leaves on the students who are going though the K-12 education system. Non-cognitive factors consists of the impact of Psychological factors, Motivational factors, Environmental surroundings, Amenities and facilities available which can transform experiences of students, deciding and achieving goals, improvement in their academic patterns, orientation towards social responsibilities etc. We will also be discussing the educational initiatives and interventions that may be “Motivation”, “Praising”, “Appraising”, “Encouragement”, etc.

articleTitle: Review on Energy Management Schemes in Wireless Ad hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Energy management in wireless network is a major critical issue. Energy efficiency of a sensor node means the amount of data delivered by a specific node into the total amount of energy expended. Higher the energy efficiency means higher the number of packets transmitted by the sensor node to reserve energy in the network. This paper highlights the requirement for energy management scheme in ad hoc wireless networking.

articleTitle: Implementation of Efficient Cache Architecture for Performance Improvement in Communication based Systems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: In advanced multimedia communication based systems, performance improvement is one of the most important issues. Data cache consumes a major portion of the whole processor power for communication applications as they are mainly data intensive. The cache architecture cannot be taken care of specifically for an application in case of an integrated communication system. As a result, a big amount of cache memory is not used. In this paper, the software-controlled cache architecture has been proposed, that improves the energy efficiency of the shared cache in an integrated communication based system. For different cache regions, data types are allocated for an application. Only the allocated cache regions are activated. The effectiveness of software-controlled cache after integration is tested in a communication based System on chip. The results show the performance improvement of the system on chip up-to a huge level on ARM-like cache architecture.

articleTitle: A Low Cost Microstrip Antennafor UWB Applications
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: A compact low cost microstrip Patch antenna(MPA) is proposed in this paper. The overall size of the proposed antenna measures 21mm x 14 mm x 1.6 mm. The simulation and analysis is done using CST Microwave Studio. The antenna parameters such as Bandwidth, input impedance, VSWR, Efficiency, Gain and Radiation pattern are simulated and analysed. The antenna resonates at wide frequency band from 3.11 to 14.254 GHz. Hence, achieving a bandwidth of 11.14GHz and a fractional bandwidth of 128.31%. The antenna is more efficient in the Ultra wide-band frequency band from 3.1 to 10.6 GHz with an average efficiency of 68 percent. The antenna is designed on a low-cost FR-4 substrate which is easily available on the market. The simulated results show that the proposed antenna has a wide range of applications such as WIMAX(3.4 to 3.6 GHz and 3.7 to 4.2 GHz), WIFi 802.11y(3.6 to 3.7), S-band(2 to 4GHz), C-band(4 to 8 GHz), X-band(8 to 12GHz), Ku-band(11.7 to 12.7GHz for downlink).

articleTitle: Realization of β Independent Stability Factor for a Biasing Circuit
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: The stability analysis of an electronic circuit is a measure of its sensitivity against the variation of collector current (IC) with respect to Ico, β and VBE parameters. An electronic circuit may be stabilize in two different ways: (a) Stabilization technique and (b) Compensation technique. In case of stabilisation technique, resistive biasing circuits are used to allow base current (IB) to vary by keeping collector current (IC) relatively constant with variations against different parameters like Ico, β and VBE. Whereas, compensation techniques refer to the use of temperature sensitive devices such as diodes, transistors, thermistors, etc,. Later schemes provide compensating currents and voltages to maintain a constant operating point. In most of the cases, this is seen that the stability factor (S) mostly depends on the value of β. Whereas β is not constant for all the transistors. So, the circuit becomes unstable. Here a biasing circuit is developed to analyze the stability factor independent of β. In this circuit the stability factor S is controlled within the range of 1 ≤ S ≤ 2.

articleTitle: Implementation of MELP Encoder on Zynq FPGA using HLS
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: For the speech communication techniques there is a lot of scope nowadays. Due to number of applications increasing, there is a need for the approach for the data compression techniques which uses bandwidth and storage space. The quality of original speech is maintained for the speech coding techniques which reduces the bit rates. The Multi-Excitation Linear Prediction (MELP)[1,3] speech coder is the Federal Standard which provides a good quality of the decoded speech. The MELP Encoder is implemented through HLS on to the Zynq-7 ZC706 FPGA Evaluation Board. The comparison of the area utilization is done at C-synthesis level, post-synthesis level, post- implementation level.

articleTitle: Electrical Distributed Generation by Industrial Waste Plastics and Muncipal Waste using Pyrolysis Process
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Industrial plastic waste constitutes one of the most crucial health and environmental problems in India. Growth of energy demand is due to urbanization, population, industrialization and also increased price rate of fuel. Hence mankind has to rely on the alternate/renewable energy sources like biomass, hydropower, geothermal energy, wind energy, solar energy, nuclear energy, etc by saving of fossil energy like crude oil, natural gas or coal. Industrial plastic waste management (IPWM) Here the oil extracted from the E- plastics used as calorific blended inputs for the electrical co generation.

articleTitle: Depictive Analysis of MANETs under Black Hole Attack
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Mobile ad-hoc network (MANET) have become a compulsive and interesting technology in recent years because of the rapid development of wireless devices. Tremendous growth and development with wide usage of internet also raises concerns about how to protect and communicate the digital information in a safe manner. Nowadays, hackers deploy variety of attacks to get valuable information and this has given rise to the threats on the MANET. One of these security threats is black hole attack in which the attacked node drops all received data packets intended for forwarding in-order to reach the destination. A synthesis of this attack has been performed by establishing an attack model of black hole. After the creation of the environment, network performance are analyzed by performing simulations in different network scenarios using NS2 simulator. The metrics chosen for studying the performance are throughput, Packet Delivery Ratio, Packet Drop.

articleTitle: Role Assignment Algorithms in Wireless Sensor Networks: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSN) consist of sensor nodes. These sensor nodes are usually used to monitor different physical or environmental conditions. Configuration of wireless sensor networks requires certain functions to be automatically assigned to sensor nodes. The most important research problem that needs to be addressed in order to support autonomous configuration of WSN is the assignment of roles to sensor nodes based on the properties of the network. These roles represent the task that a specific node is supposed to fulfill. The assignment of roles and task to the suitable sensor nodes would ensure the increase in performance and longevity of the network. This paper discusses the different role assignment algorithms that are used in wireless sensor networks.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Optimization of Multi-Cloud with Replica and Data Segmentation using Optical Protocols
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: In this research paper we analyze on the Replica & Data Segmentation If at any time one master replica is designated to process all the requests, then we are talking about the primary-backup scheme predominant in high-availability servers and their databases. On the other side, if any replica processes a request and then distributes a new state, then this is a multi-primary scheme. Transactional replication is typically used in server-to-server scenarios that require high throughput, including improving scalability and availability data warehousing and reporting integrating data from multiple sites integrating heterogeneous data. Cloud computing security is the set of control-based technologies and policies designed to adhere to regulatory compliance rules and protect information, data applications and infrastructure associated with cloud computing use. The security for current server cloud provider to transferring to another provider should work as shown below figure. We are in under planning to use the algorithm like RSA for security's and also for the pairing and large number operations to implement some of our cryptographic protocols.

articleTitle: Recognition of Arabic Characters using Spiking Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Text Recognition is one of the active and challenging areas of research in the pattern recognition field. It covers many applications like automatic number plate recognition, bank cheques, aid of reading for blind, and hand-written document conversion into form of structural text. In the present work, the spiking neural network (SNN) model is utilized for the identification of Arabic characters in a character set. The structure of considered neural network consists of two layers with Izhekevich neurons. Remote Supervised Method (ReSuMe) has been used as a learning rule for training. Also, the recognition of Arabic characters has been considered based on spike Neural Networks. The network could successfully recognize character set consisting of 28 isolating Arabic characters.

articleTitle: Optimisation of Power Electronic Switches in Cascaded H-Bridge Multilevel Inverter by using Bidirectional Switches
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Multilevel inverter is a brilliant topological scheme for DC to AC conversion. Multilevel inverter blends desired voltage wave profile from numerous levels of DC voltages. Multilevel inverter has many inherent problems due to usage of higher number of semiconductor switches. This may leads excess system size and price of the inverter also increases. The increased complexity of the controlling circuits also creates problem. Complex control algorithm needs to be worked out to optimise the operation. The objective of this discussion is to work for a modified design of multilevel inverter by optimising the number of switches used in a particular multilevel inverter without affecting the performance of the system and its suitability to high power application.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Eliminate Low Order Harmonics in Asymmetrical Multilevel Inverter
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: A major problem in conventional multilevel inverter is that an increase in power switches and dc sources to increase the level in output voltage leads to increased cost, losses and size of the inverter. To solve this problem, many new topologies with reduced number of switches and dc sources have been presented in literature. But, harmonic distortion in new multilevel inverter topologies still needs improvement. This paper unleashes a new idea to minimize the total harmonic distortion as well as low order harmonics in the output voltage. Here, a new multilevel inverter topology based on modified H-bridge inverter is used which requires less number of components as compared with traditional cascaded multilevel inverter (CMLI) for equal number of level in output voltage. In order to address above issues, in this article, the selective harmonic elimination technique is employed and the switching angles are calculated using Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) method. Performance of the employed scheme has been evaluated using MATLAB based simulation for 31-level inverter. The promising nature of the performance projects that proposed modulation technique can be employed for minimizing the THD in output voltage for newly developed topologies.

articleTitle: Enhanced Performance of Integrated Power System Stabilizer–Effect of Operating Conditions
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: This paper presents robust design of a Power System Stabilizer (PSS) using novel concept of integrating the Taguchi technique with particle swarm optimization technique for stabilization of a synchronous generator connected to an infinite bus. The integrated Particle swarm optimization power system stabilizer (PSOPSS) is capable of tolerating uncertainty and imprecision to a greater extent. Simulation results for a Single Machine Infinite Bus System (SMIB) are obtained and compared with conventional power system stabilizer (CPSS) results. The settling time and peak over shoot in case of PSOPSS is found to be better compared to conventional PSS. The results are obtained by simulations using MATLAB/SIMULINK.

Author Keywords: Particle swarm optimization power system stabilizer

articleTitle: Multiple Distributed Generator and Capacitor Placement in Distribution Network for Voltage Profile Improvement and Network Loss Reduction
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: In this paper the problem of multiple distributed generators (DG units) placement is addressed to achieve improvement in voltage profile and reduction in losses of distribution network. Using Improved Analytical (IA) method the optimal location of DG is identified to reduce the network losses. To improve the voltage profile, at an optimal location, optimal capacity of VAr injection is provided. The results have been obtained for the optimal placement up to three DG placement on a IEEE 33 bus system which is used as benchmark problem by many authors for the analysis of distribution system. The result of the proposed methodology is compared with some of the existing techniques to improve the voltage profile and to decrease the network losses. It has been observed that there has been remarkable improvement in the performance of the network by employing proposed technique in comparison with other existing methods. The algorithm has been developed as a software package using MATLAB.

articleTitle: Perceptions of Millennials Towards Social Media Privacy Issues: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Objective: As the usage of social media becomes permeating, data of user might be easily disclosed and the privacy concern for social media is a big doubt that millennials tend to ignore due to lack of knowledge of privacy and safety. This research will investigate the perception of millennials towards social media privacy issues. Methodology: The research was organized as an online survey questionnaire distributed to 154 participants of different age group in UK, India, Malaysia, Middle-East and Vietnam. This study utilised factor analysis, multiple regression and correlation for analysis of data. Result and conclusion: The findings empirically validate the cognitive process of privacy concerns in which perception of instruction, perceived privacy risk and perceived privacy control are revealed to be most concerned factors in affecting privacy across different context in social networking websites.

articleTitle: MEMS and Vision based Gesture Driven System for Patients
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: This paper suggests an idea of a system based on gesture detection which can be helpful for the patients. The pre-defined actions made by the patients can be translated through an embedded system which can be used to communicate with the medical staff. The proposed system is useful in improving the communication between the patient and the medical staff which reduces the burden on them. Gesture recognition can be achieved by eliminating unwanted background, non-gesture hand motions and by using proper illumination. Here we detect the hand by determining its canter, then we analyze the deviations in the finger's location, and finally recognize the gesture.

articleTitle: Implementation of Optimised Daugman’s Procedure for Iris Authentication
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: The iris texture steadiness is unparalled in scenery because of which it is best for entity identification purposes. But When we come to the performance its conformity rate is very elevated. Iris recognition Is the one of biometric technique which has drawn the great alertness of scientist due to equilibrium of iris pattern. Many research has been done in this area. Majority of authors has proposed circular Hough transform [1] but there is problem with this techniques is that high frequency wasting away of time and memory. We have implemented the authentication for bank locker. But still there are many applications.

articleTitle: Performance Testing of Electrostatic Precipitator Applicable for Clean Combustion Devices for Producer Gas Application
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Electrostatic precipitators (ESPs) are well known particle separation devices used widely in several industries. It is found that applications of ESPs for gasification based power plants are not reported and there is no clarity on its performance in this environment. The gas output from the biomass gasifiers contains particulates, dust & tar (P&T) at a fairly low concentration levels of the order of a few PPM and still can be objectionable to applications and devices where the gas is used over a period of time. The current practice of having finer fabric filters work with a demand for higher O&M operations. In this context it is essential to bring the P&T to as lower level as possible so that the equipments using this in the downstream do not get affected.

articleTitle: Pervasive Security of Internet Enabled Host Services
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: This research paper covers all the security challenges faced by pervasive computing which includes expanding the range for computation and various privacy and user interaction issues that a user may confront. We also talk about the actual security requirements and the existing approaches for safeguarding the online experiences and also the possible attacking approaches adopted by the attackers over time by getting better of the existent loopholes in the security paradigm for instance the ARP Spoofing and the attacks where the attacker masquerades the identity of one of the host(s) and can gain access to various sensitive information being transmitted. Finally, we discussed the best approaches to be adopted for a better and secured online security experience overall and then we conclude the report elaborating the same.

articleTitle: Simulation Modelling of DC-DC Converter for Grid Side Connected Inverter
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: With the increasing demand of electrical energy, it became the necessity of human being and due to this its generation and utilization become one of the important concerns of the researchers, developers as well as for the industrialist. Different methodologies are achieved to harvest energy and convert it into required form with efficient use. In this paper a boost converter is used for the conversion of low DC voltage into high DC voltage with remodeled inverter and then voltage source inverter (VSI) synchronization to the grid is done. This paper consists of modeling of DC-DC converter for grid side connected inverter and presented the related output waveforms. Proposed circuit is simulated in MATLAB/SIMULINK 2013 and simulation results are provided.

articleTitle: An Application of Information Entropy for Ophthalmologists’ Decision Making
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: The decision process of medical Ophthalmology vary in the degree to which a patient is fit with respect to various factors such as age, spectacle prescription, astigmatic, tear production rate, etc., In the past rough set theory has been used to study such decision processes. But no efficient procedures have been developed to deal with the complicating aspects of medical Ophthalmology. Therefore an attempt has been made to analyze the inconsistencies of the decision making process. In real life many types of contact lenses are in practice and there are several factors that influence the decision as to which type, if any, to suit. The decision support system adopted by an ophthalmologist is defined by the use of information entropy. Information entropy theory has been used in the method of analyzing the objects and attributes of the decision table for reducing its uncertainty. Then, the priorities of the attributes are determined. The results can address the ophthalmologists in their decision making process.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Wavelet based Spectrum Sensing and Conventional Spectrum Sensing in Fading Environment for Cognitive Radios
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: This paper discusses about the performance analysis of wavelet based spectrum sensing and conventional spectrum sensing methods in fading environment for cognitive radios. Receiver Operating Characteristics (ROC) which gives the Probability of detection versus Probability of false alarm in terms of signal and noise power is considered to be important performance metrics of Cognitive Radio. The effects of fading is also considered while evaluating the performance in this work. Analysis of results indicates that wavelet based spectrum sensing has an edge over conventional spectrum sensing technique.

articleTitle: Secure Perceptual Hashing Scheme for Image using Encryption
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: A perceptual image hash function maps an image to a short binary string based on an images appearance to human eye. This paper proposes a theoretical analysis of full perceptual hashing systems that use a quantization module followed by a crypto-compression module. Finally, several experiments are conducted to validate the approach, by Gaussian noise and JPEG compression. Finally the image is encrypted using secret key called SHA-I (Secure Hash Alogorithm-1) of128 bits.

articleTitle: Automated Evaluation of Sperm Membrane Structural Integrity using Open Source Software
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Assisted reproductive techniques like, In Vitro Fertilization (IVF), Intra Cytoplasmic Sperm Injection (ICSI) and Intracytoplasmic morphologically-selected sperm injection (IMSI). Live sperm is necessary to maximize the chances of fertilization. Using sperm vitality analysis we can achieve fertilization with very few spermatozoa. By combining good sperm preparation techniques with sperm vitality analysis, it is possible to optimize the results, as well as number of opportunities for conception. In this paper we developed a MACRO on IMAGEJ platform which will identify live and dead sperms. And results are compared with visual method.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Dither based Approach for Alleviation of Blocking Artifact in Image Compression
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: To identify the forgery in DCT based compressed image the two significant properties are quantization artifacts and blocking artifacts. Image compression is really real substance for specific points of view in the area of intuitive media correspondence. By utilizing Image compression we can able to use the image with lesser number of information bits. Block based discrete cosine Transform (BDCT) is long set up utilized Transform for the two static and continuous image. While we compress any sort of image by lossy type of image compression procedure at that point there will be loss of information bits, we need to encounter undesirable curios ringing and blocking artifacts and when we need to reestablish such type of image then we confront issue of obscuring of image, which is called annoying artifacts around the block of the image. Block-based Discrete Cosine Transform create blocking artifact near block boundaries in reconstructed image at high compression. In this paper, we are going to reduce blocking artifacts at medium and low level compression by using Anti-forensic dither followed by linear and nonlinear filtering. The decrease in blocking artifacts is ordered by the parameters PSNR and MSSIM We can compare these parameters for different Quantization factor, on the basis of the MATLAB simulation results for various images.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on Clustering of Gene Expression Dataset-its Prediction and Mining
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Our ability to assemble genome-wide expression data has far exceeded the ability of our diminutive human brains to analyses the raw data. We can refine the data down to a more understandable level by grouping the genes into a smaller number of categorization and then analyzing those. Clustering is one of the most popular techniques in gene expression. Many clustering algorithms have been initiated to analyze gene expression data, but less supervision is available to help choose among them. The evaluation of feasible and applicable clustering algorithms is becoming an important issue in today's bioinformatics research. It is a method of grouping data into different clusters, in which each cluster must have data of great similarity and high dissimilarity with other cluster data. The basic clustering algorithms are K-mean and K-medoids. This paper presents a literature survey on the clustering application in gene expression. An attempt is made to provide a guide for the researchers who are working in the area of gene expression and data clustering.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Routing Protocols, Classification and Comparison in Wireless Sensor Networks: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) is used to monitor the environmental conditions in the deployed area under sectors like military, health, agriculture, disaster areas, etc. The wireless sensor nodes are very small in size and are powered by a battery having limited lifetime. Hence to achieve longevity and reliability, the foremost concern while designing protocols and applications is minimizing energy consumption and maximizing network lifetime. In this paper we review the popular energy efficient Routing protocols and its strategies to consume the nodes energy efficiently and hence increase the life time of the wireless sensor network.

articleTitle: Managing Enterprise Data and Providing a Personalized Employee Data Visualization
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: In this Digital world storage area capacity required for an Enterprise is quite huge, and processing that Big Data is one of the major challenging areas in today's information technology. As the heterogeneous data from the various sources grow rapidly, there should be some proficient way for data storage for each enterprise. Most of the Enterprises have a tendency to migrate their data in to servers with high processing capability to handle variety and voluminous data. Major problem that arises in such big data servers of an Enterprise is the process involved in segregating data according to their types. In this research, an efficient methodology is proposed which handles the segregation of data inside a server with multi valued distribution based clustering. These clustering based solutions provide an efficient visualization of varying data in the server and also a separate visualization of employee data too. The paper discusses about the simulation of the clustering technique with respect to an Enterprise and visualization of file storage structure and categorization of data.Keywords- Big Data, Data storage servers, Data Analytics, Clusterization, Visualization.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Wireless Sensor Network using Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Wireless sensor network are spatially autonomous sensor that are deployed which is used to monitor either physical or environmental condition like temperature, humidity, pressure and many more. These are the group of transducers that have a communications infrastructure which is used for monitoring and recording the conditions. A sensor network consists of multiple detection stations which can be defined as sensor nodes, each one of containing the feature like as small, lightweight and portable. The important disadvantage of these sensor nodes is the energy constraints. As the replacement of battery in hostile condition sometimes become impossible. To solve this issue various algorithms is approached like LEACH, SEP, HEED. Selection of cluster head is one of the concepts of clustering approach which can reduce the problem of energy constraints up to some extend. In this paper we are going to use fuzzy logic concept which take parameter like residual energy, overhead and distance between the nodes from the base station for the choice of cluster head so that it further send the data to base station and the concept of data aggregation which is going to used to avoid the redundant data problem. Mamdani's rule is going to used for the proper selection of cluster head. The results have been obtained from MATLAB and shows that the result that is obtained in terms of network lifetime, network throughput, alive nodes by proposed algorithm is much better than the LEACH protocol.

articleTitle: Analysis of Various Strategies for Improvement in Performance of OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Presently a days, there is colossal request of high information rate in order to suit tremendous number of clients. This need has additionally prompted the prerequisite of change in the present wireless advancements. As OFDM is the physical layer in the majority of the present wireless systems. This paper exhibits various ways in which the performance of OFDM system can be improved. The performance parameter varies with the type of application. In case the demand of application is accuracy, BER (bit error rate) should be low but the receiver circuitry becomes more complex to decode complex channel coding techniques. In addition to make the communication more reliable, precoding techniques can be concatenated with channel encoding techniques.

articleTitle: Generation of Binary Sequences Having Better Odd Correlation and Linear Complexity Property Compared to Gold Codes for use in Global Navigation Satellites Systems (GNSS) Applications
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Often in GNSS systems due to environmental issues the desired signal to be received may be degraded and attenuated due to multipath or some other reasons. Also the binary sequences used in GNSS systems are having low linear complexity and hence are easy to attack. To overcome above said problems it is essential to propose a method to generate binary sequences derived from chaotic real sequences which are found to have better odd correlation property than the GPS Ll C/A Signal and hence are more resistant to environment variations such as multipath or interference. The binary sequences generated from the proposed method are found to have very large linear complexity as compared with GPS Ll C/A Signals. This paper also presents the odd correlation properties of 32 GPS Ll C/A sequences, and compared with the odd correlation properties of the generated sequences in detail.

articleTitle: Pre-Coding using Different Detection Algorithms in MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Pre-coding is a general understanding of beamforming to achieve the transmission diversity of the signal. Basically transmitter sends the information which is already coded according to the known knowledge about the channel conditions to the receiver. The pre-coding technique leads to achieve a good performance by eliminating the degradation effects even in the correlation environment upon the channel in the communication system. In this paper, the different detection algorithms: Zero forcing (ZF), Minimum mean square error (MMSE) and Block diagonalization (BD) are used in pre-coding. Many solutions have been proposed for the Co-Channel Interference problem. The main aim of this paper is to select the most suitable Coding techniques to adopt. The analysis is carried by assuming the channel as Rayleigh and modulation scheme is QPSK with 4×4 MIMO system.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Isolated Multi-Output DC-DC Power Supply with Fixed and Programmable Voltage Levels
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Currently, most of the day-to-day electrical and electronic appliances require DC inputs of different voltage levels. Therefore, to use them in a DC micro-grid, DC-DC converters with multiple voltage levels are required. Standardization in DC micro-grid is not yet done. Hence, every micro-grid has to use specially designed converters. Switched mode power supplies, now-a-days, are having high efficiency (70- 80%), small size and light weight. Hence, these switching regulators are replacing the conventional linear regulators in many applications. In early days, the control circuitry is made up of discrete transistor stages or controlling the duty cycle of switching transistors. Now, control circuitry consisting integrated circuit and microcontrollers. This paper presents the design of isolated multi-output DC-DC power supply where input is taken from batteries or ultra-capacitors. Multiple voltage levels are obtained by designing the multi-winding transformer and further converting them into DC. Fixed output voltage levels are obtained as 5 V and 20 V, while programmable output voltage level is designed (50 V-140 V) by using DC-DC boost converter controlled with PI controller. This power supply is designed and simulated in MATLAB Simulink.

articleTitle: Keystroke Dynamics Support for Authentication
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: In 21st century, we are handicapped without Internet and user online services whenever available. Authentication is at most important for security while accessing online services, however users may have a frustrating experience if unnecessary multi-factor authentication is implemented. In this paper, keystroke dynamics is discussed as a support factor for authentication and study on the keystroke dynamics methods, metrics and various approaches along with challenges it present.

articleTitle: A Bangla Semantic Parser using Context-Free-Grammar
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: This research work describes a computer system for understanding the parsing of Bangla sentences. It draws on recent developments in Natural Language Processing (NLP) research to look at the past, present, and future of NLP technology in a new light. The research work of Bangla Language Processing (BLP) was started in late1980s in Bangladesh and it already produced some substantive results. NLP is a theory-motivated range of computational techniques for the automatic analysis and representation of human language. Here the researchers present a semantic parser for analyzing Bangla language semantics applying Bangla Lexicon. Semantic parsing augments the stratum of comprehension of NLP than the syntactic parsing, that is primarily indulges in untangling the syntactic ambiguities of the words. In this work, the researchers have tried to develop a Context-Free-Grammar (CFG) for semantic parser. It is the grammar that consist rules with a single symbol on the left- hand side of the rewrite rules. The researchers have tried to make a rule based grammar using CFG. Tokenize of sentence is extensive deed of this research. According to every token, the researchers present their pronunciation and morphological attachment. Finally, the researchers have analyzed Bangla language semantics applying Bangla lexicon.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Control System and Health Monitoring System (HMS) for Human Robot Interaction
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: This paper emphasizes more on the technical detail of how the robot will respond to various activities by coordinating the movement of each part in order to mimic the facial expression and display their performance on dual monitor as per the change in parameters. The work is basically realized on Panda Board in a linux platform, where different dynamixel RX, AX series for head movement (roll, pitch, yaw) and micro servo motors for different expressions are carried simultaneously using threading and Serial communication. Health monitoring system on dual display was implemented to display the change in parameter for each movement. Whole System is realized on Panda Board using two Processors i.e., Arm A9.

articleTitle: Formant Synthesis of Kannada Consonant Vowel (CV) Co-Articulations
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: This paper discusses on the implementation of Pitch Synchronous Parameter Update Algorithm for synthesizing Consonant Vowel (CV) co-articulations for Kannada Consonants with respect to vowels using a Klatt class Formant Synthesizer. The synthesized co-articulations are subjected to perception test and out of 192 CV utterences, 176 were correctly synthesized.

articleTitle: TaCbF-“Trending Architecture for Content based Filtering using Data Mining”
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Online Social Network provides a support for the users. The System provides most of the routine Online Social Network related activities. For Online Social Network users, the system provides a facility to control irrelevant messages pos ted on their user wall, to avoid unwanted messages and it is called as Filtered wall (FW) where it is achieved through a specific rule-based system. Based on the user's area of interest, Machine Learning based classifier is used for labeling messages, which support the content based filtering. System provide a validation process based on content type and provide a platform for the trending topics which includes live stream data, all under one roof.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Cognitive Radio Network under Matched Filter Detection
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: The performance of cognitive radio network depends on how efficiently the Secondary Users (SUs) can sense a Primary User (PU) on a physical channel. In matched filter detection the maximum signal to noise ratio (SNR) is achieved at receiving end can be used as the detection of technique of cognitive radio network. In this paper we analyzed the impact of False Alarm (FA), length of test statistics and threshold SNR in acquiring proper detections or sensing of PU by SUs. From the profile of probability of detection against SNR taking FA as a parameter we determine the optimum condition of the network based on matched filter detection. Finally the analytical results are verified by simulation with sufficient confidence level.

articleTitle: Design and Verification of Fault Tolerance IP Core using SIHFT Technique
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Processors are widely used in embedded systems to deliver high speed computation, high power efficiency at a very low cost. 8085 processor is a general purpose processor widely used in embedded design. However, in nanoscale regime these designs are becoming more sensible to transient faults caused by radiations. Thus temperance of soft error is major concern. Nowadays, a new technique Software Implemented Hardware Fault Tolerance (SIHFT) is used to safeguard devices against soft error at very low cost, on the other hand this technique has certain disadvantages like overheads in design like area, memory, and power consumption. In this work, we implement set of techniques on which we use different set of error correction and detection rules. Furthermore, low overhead technique is also implemented. An elaborated discussion of results specifying execution time and area overheads is presented.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Vehicle Tracking and Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: As being the fast growing economy India is one of the most populous countries in the world. We are facing terrible road congestion problems nowadays. Due to space and cost, infrastructure growth normally slows down and numbers of vehicles are increasing day by day. The vehicle tracking and monitoring system is used for monitoring a vehicle from any location to any other location at real time. It provides safe environment to all who travels. It would make use of growing technology that based on Embedded Linux board namely Raspberry Pi and stores database at real time. The proposed system works on Global Positioning System (GPS) and Global System for Mobile Communication (GSM) and it is used for vehicle tracking and monitoring mechanism. The GPS gives current location of the vehicle and the GSM is used for communicating with owner by sending an alert message to his or her mobile. The vehicle whose position is required on the web page and who is needed to monitor at real time would make use of this proposed system. Also if the vehicle's speed goes beyond the specified limit of the value, then also a warning message will be sent from system to the owner mobile. All this information is stored on the web page at client or owner side. This system also features main attractive part that is an automatic high beam and low beam headlight system. System also uses anti-theft system, it provides security before someone tries to steal it. The main purpose of a system is that it should be easily installed and there should be future scope for the improvement.

articleTitle: Development, Testing and Performance Analysis of SPV Powered 0.5HP AC Water Pumping System
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: This paper presents the implementation and testing of SPV powered 0.5HP AC water pumping system. DC pumps are widely used in SPV based systems. However, the cost employed for DC pumps is much larger in comparison to conventional AC pumps. In the proposed system inverter is designed for 400 W SPV panel connected to 0.5HP pump. The experimental setup is built in Energy Park, Basaveshwar Engineering College (Autonomous), Bagalkot, India. Further, performance analysis of the SPV water pump under varying conditions of solar radiation is carried out. Solar radiation, SPV output, Inverter output, Inverter efficiency, Flowrate from pump, Hydraulic power output and Pump efficiency are experimentally obtained and tabulated. Performance results revealed that, proposed model delivers 45-50 liters of water per minute from the depth of 3m water tank. Maximum efficiency of inverter and entire unit is obtained at highest solar radiation of 1195W/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The results indicate the efficient working of the implemented system for at least 4 hrs, between 11:00am to 3:00pm of a day. The proposed concept reduces the cost and decreases dependency on conventional energy sources, while satisfying the water requirement in small scale agriculture and gardening.

articleTitle: DC-DC Converter Integrated with Asymmetrical Multi-Level Inverter for Solar PV Application
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: In recent decades, increased energy demand and depletion of conventional energy sources has drawn attraction towards the use of renewable energy sources. Solar energy is one such a non-depleting source which can be utilized to generate an electricity with the help of solar photovoltaic. Globally, there are lot of research is going on in the conversion of solar energy in to useful electrical energy. Now a days, multi-level inverters are drawing lot of attention for the researchers due to their advantages. Use of dc-dc converters have become a common converter in many of the applications. The integration of dc-dc converter and multi-level inverter has advantage in elimination of transformer in the converter. The paper proposes a dc-dc converter integrated with asymmetrical multi-level inverter for solar PV application, with separate sources and also for a single source. The proposed converters are simulated in MATLAB/Simulink with and without a filter circuit. Output voltage/current waveforms and the total harmonic distortion is observed. The feasibility of the proposed converter is validated.

articleTitle: Data Classification using Active Learning based Data Modification: An Application to Churn Prediction
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Support Vector Machine (SVM) is on one of its kind of data mining algorithm, tends to always give away the global optimum solution to any given problem because of its convex optimization problem solving approach. SVM learns from the given training data and generates a linear hyperplane classifying the given instances. The training instances which are near this separating hyperplane are called support vectors, using which predictions are obtained. In other words, SVM considers the support vectors as important instances for prediction purposes and ignores other instances which are much away from hyperplane boundary. In this project the ability of SVM i.e. extraction of support vectors is explored further and active learning based synthetic data generation (nearest to the support vectors) is employed. Synthetic data generation near support vectors would provide the classification algorithm (Naïve Bayes algorithm in this project) with some extra and suitable instances to learn from which in-turn expected to result in improving the prediction accuracy of the classifier used. Results have shown that Naïve Bayes classifier yielded superior accuracy using the modified dataset when compared to the accuracy yielded using original data available.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Different Statistical Fading Channel Models for WIMAX System
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: WIMAX is one of most important 4G technology being used nowadays for broadband wireless access systems. This paper analyzes the performance of WIMAX system for different fading channel models in terms of bit error rate, throughput and spectral efficiency with user mobility of 50 km/hr for QPSK. Initially, the effect of different K factors for Rician channel is evaluated. Then, the performance of different fading channel models namely, Rayleigh, Rician and Nakagami is compared.

articleTitle: Congestion Control Mechanism in Networks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Lots of unwanted data transmission make the network lead to a problem of congestion. One solution to reduce congestion is to understand the availability of bandwidth, processing power and memory. In real practice it is very difficult to know about the availability and then do the data transmission. One parameter is considered here, that is the available empty space in the memory so that the data loss won't happen which avoid retransmission of data which leads to reduce congestion. Basically when data transmission needs to happen, the available queue length of all the nodes are known to each other. To update the queue length, all the nodes periodically sends the current queue length to all the other nodes. When it's periodic update again it leads to congestion. The proposed algorithm is not going to send periodic update regarding the status of the queue length. When the queue length reaches threshold in any node, that node sends a caution message to all the other nodes that not to send data. So that number of periodic updates will get reduced and by that congestion will be reduced.

articleTitle: Conditions for Identifiability of Mixed Graphs using Simple Paths
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Network Tomography is an upcoming field to identify link metrics and improve the quality of network monitoring. From linear algebra, we know that, if the number of unknown link metrics is equal to the number of links within the network, then the network is uniquely identifiable. Previous works include identifying link metrics of networks, in which the links were either undirected or directed bidirectional. By keeping in mind that the link metrics are additive and constant, the focus of this paper is on mixed networks with both undirected and directed unidirectional paths. The method employed involves dividing the network into subgraphs and obtaining the conditions of identifiability on the network without the inclusion of monitoring cycles.

articleTitle: Accurate Classification of Remote Sensed Data for Landuse/Land Class of Mangaluru Coastal Region
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Classification of remotely sensed data for land use/land class is one of the key areas for researchers in remote sensing fields. Classification of remote sensed data is necessary for the better categorization of semi urban land features such as wetlands, forests, agriculture and other land and water types. For the accurate classification of remotely sensed data, a high quality data set is needed. In the present research study, to classify the data set, PAN sharpened(fused) images are considered. Image fusion provides better quality and more informative image data set as compared to original data. The performance of different fusion techniques are then evaluated to select the best possible technique which gives better result for image classification.

articleTitle: An Improved Analysis of Heart MRI Images using the Morphological Operations
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Heart disease is the most prevalent kind of disease even among the young people, which has logged the maximum number of lives so far. Earlier it was a disease which claimed people above 50 years of age, but as of now it has it is consuming even the lives of small children with congenital heart diseases. This part of the work also has focused on the cardiac MRI images related to congenital disorders among children in the age group of 2 years to 17 years of age. Medical image enhancement technique is the need of the hour for quick and accurate diagnosis of heart ailments and for medical intervention to take over accordingly. In this paper we focused more on the morphological operations in continuation of our research work in our earlier paper. Different morphological operations were tried over the pre-processed images and the experimental results showed that the opening operation gave a least error measure of all. Various error estimates over these operations were taken, like MSE, RMSE, MAE, etc. were calculated for all MR images and was found the opening operation had a less error compared to other operations, which implies that opened images have more clarity than the other operations.

articleTitle: Efficient Hardware Architecture for Amalgam of Blowfish and Rc6
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: These days, Wi-Fi is a well-liked Technology. For it there is requirement of Faster data transfer as well as high security. Presently Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) is used in Wi-Fi that is more secured comparative to other encryption algorithms. But it's not so fast because the complex functions it has. In this paper a hardware architecture is proposed with inner-loop pipelining, loop unrolling for the amalgam of Blowfish and RC6. The used algorithm uses two random numbers “a” and “w” that helps in removing weak key attack and Known plaintext attack of Blowfish. Also the used algorithm uses one S-Box by overlapping process that eliminates the collision key attack of Blowfish. The used algorithm requires less cycles than blowfish and RC6.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach of Creating a Self Owned ‘Dropbox’ using Open Source Software
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: This paper aims at the creation of a self owned cloud user space using an open source service called ownCloud. LINUX environment. A cloud service is used in our day to day activities. We use a cloud service like http://www.dropbox.com to save pictures, documents and many a times music and video files. This paper was written to overcome some of the disadvantages of many cloud services. One such major disadvantage is that the services are not free and are proprietary softwares. But ownCloud is a free and open source software.

articleTitle: Automatic Blood Vessels Segmentation & Extraction in Fundus Images for Identification
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Personal identification and authentication is a vital problem in any biometric application. The advancements in the field of biometric research enable us to find more complex methodologies which are accurate for authentication. Biometrics technology identifies the persons identity based upon his physiological or behavioural traits. The human retina provides one of the most reliable biometric technologies which is more accurate and secure. The retina is an internal organ of the eye, yet visible externally which is well protected from the environment and remains stable over time. The retinal blood vessel is extracted, which is unique for one person even in the case of twins and it is used for identification and authentication. Gray scale conversion from colored retinal image, resizing the retinal image and local contrast enhancement is performed for pre-processing the retinal image. Fractal dimension is calculated using box counting algorithm. Branch and crossover points are used as features for Morphological Segmentation and Branching point method. Euclidean distance measure is used for retinal identification process for fractal dimension and bifurcation methods. Vascular skeleton is segmented using morphological method called watershed transformation. The performance of all the three methods is evaluated.

articleTitle: Image in Painting through Non Local Total Variation by Flower Pollination Approach and Predictive Guided Patch Mixing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: In this paper, we improved the formulation of exemplar-based image inpainting using metric labeling by flower pollination optimization. In FPA, we used greedy approach for optimization of metric convergence in exemplar method, which increases the total variation, cost but reduce the convergence time. For reducing the cost, we used optimize number of masked images selected by Exception maximization method, which reduces the cost and increase the efficiency of total variation method. We used the parameter of quality score and cost on different type of four images and analyzed the PSNR, quality score in comparison with existing method. Experimental results show that the proposed approach significantly improves the MSE, PSNR and quality as compared to the existing method. There is 8-9% increase in quality score of inpainted images then proposed method and also 25-30 % increase in PSNR then the proposed method.Computional complexity is reduced in proposed method which in turn reduces time.

articleTitle: DBQA: Multi-Environment Analyzer for Query Execution Time and Cost
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: In today's computational world, many ways are available for storing and retrieving database. Numbers of commercial database management systems are available in the market with their superiors. The primary goal of DBMSs is to provide a way to store and retrieve database information that is both convenient and efficient. The question is which one to be selected according to our need and usage. While selecting DBMSs the main agenda is its performance. The performance of the system measured in terms of cost and time. If a larger query process with minimum time and cost, we can say the performance of the system is good. The care of performance is taken by query optimization technique in query processing. This is a core part of the paper; in the paper, we have developed DBQA (Database Query Analyzer) to analyze performance of the top four DBMSs on select queries with respect to time and cost. The DBMSs used for performance are MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle and MS SQL Server. The standard dataset DBLP have used for testing with 9360103 records.

articleTitle: Intelligent based Distributed Generation Management for Radial Test System
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Penetration of renewable energy based Distributed Generation (DG) units to power system provides potential benefits to conventional distribution system. In this paper the solar and wind DG units are managed along with grid supply for different load condition. The simulation is carried out on IEEE 13 bus radial system using MATLAB/Simulink 2014a.

articleTitle: Study and Implementation of Clustering Algorithms in R
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: clustering is a process in which we group the data by finding similarities between data based on their characteristics. These groups are called cluster. In clustering, there is a division of data into groups of similar objects. These groups are the clusters, consists of objects that are similar between themselves and dissimilar compared to objects of other groups. Clustering is unsupervised learning technique, based on the concept of maximize intra-clustering and minimize inter- clustering. Nowadays, clustering of biological dataset is the widely researched topic among computer science. Bio- informatics has become area that receive most of the attention of data mining techniques. Generally, bio- informatics targets to solve complicated problems like gene categorization and its functionality, gene expression analysis of data obtained from micro- array experiments etc. These clustering techniques are addressed with R. Clustering techniques are used to analyze the structure of biological data. There are many different methods but we study k- means, Hierarchical and Density- based clustering algorithm for Biological Data using R programming tool.

articleTitle: A Transformerless Single Phase Shunt Active Hybrid Power Filter for Power Quality Improvement for Electrified Transportations
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: The growing high demand of renewable sources of energy to meet the electrical needs is leading to various energy management and power quality issues. So a transformerless single phase shunt active hybrid power filter is proposed to enhance the power quality issues in single phase systems with non-linear load applications. This paper assists and focuses on improving electricvehicle load connection to the grid. Polyvalent hybrid topology is also presented that allows harmonic isolation and compensation of voltage distortions that could absorb or inject the auxiliary power to the grid. The simulations and experimental results presented in this paper demonstrate the effectiveness ofthe proposed topology.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Ammunition For The Data Security And Privacy In The Multi-Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: In this research paper, we analyse on the multi-cloud transferring data (information) with securities protocols. This decision is reasonably well explained by the fact that most of the current backbone of need of multiple cloud service providers(agent) which allow you to do computing or utilization of their resources based on the security techniques which allow you to transferring data from one servers(node) to any other or many. Moreover, we utilize the mathematical equation, security constrained and the accessibility for everyone through the network. Here the mathematical formula is designed for server-to-server (nodes to nodes) transfer the data and its authenticity with automation for exchanging information and can do synchronization between severs. Purpose of this research is to increase resources scalability and marge the many cloud providers into one hand accessibility.

articleTitle: Optimal Dynamic Scheduling with Overall Constraints for Large Scale Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Generally large power systems have a lot of generator units, nodes and lines. It causes the size of optimization problem of large scale. For dynamic scheduling, the size will add again because it involves the ramp rate, and generator capability curves. Where usage of the generator capability curves intactly will cause size of optimization problem to be a very large. For special power system, low absorption of the reactive power, the excitation limits can be approached so that reduces the size of optimization problem. This paper approaches on the excitation limits with the minimum and maximum reactive power limits to obtain simpler generator capability curves, which is expected to reduce the inequality constraints. The proposed methodology will be able to reduce computation time and more effective for large-scale power systems. From the simulations show that the proposed method can work very well and satisfactory.

articleTitle: Relative Pitch Variation Algorithm for Modification of Pitch in Emotion Conversion
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: This paper propose an algorithm in emotion conversion of neutral speech signal to target signals like sad speech, fear speech and anger speeches. As pitch plays an important role in emotion expression, a method called Relative pitch variation is proposed for modification of pitch contour for converting neutral speech to target emotional speech. The converted Sad, Fear and Anger speech signal are obtained by modifying prosodic parameters like pitch range, pitch frequency, energy and duration contour. The target speech is compared with resultant speech obtained by modifying only the pitch contour and also have observed the improvements in quality of expression due to modification of energy and duration.

articleTitle: Computation of Stability Regions using Boundary Locus and Kronecker Summation Methods
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: In this paper the computation of all stabilizing PI controllers for third order systems are obtained using Boundary locus and Kronecker summation method. Stabilizing PI controllers in the (k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub>, k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub>) plane guarantees the stability of a feedback system. The Kronecker summation method needs the explicit equation in terms of controller parameters that defining the stability boundary in parameter space. The explicit expression needs the characteristic equation. Using this explicit expression, auxiliary characteristic equation is formulated using Kronecker summation operation. This auxiliary characteristic equation defines the stability boundary. The stabilizing region obtained using this method is compared with boundary locus method. The third order systems are considered to show the effectiveness of these methods and are simulated using Matlab.

articleTitle: Frequency Reconfigurable Dual Band MIMO Antenna using Pentagon Slot Resonator With Improved Bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: In this paper, Multiple Input Multiple Output (MIMO) antenna with dual band frequency reconfiguration for reduction of mutual coupling is presented. The proposed antenna consists of multiple stubs incorporated in antenna design. The radiating elements of antenna support bands of 1.5 GHz (GPS) and 2.4 GHz (Wi-Fi) frequency. The two PIN diodes are placed on slot line in order to control the current flowing through the radiator. All simulated results are compared and confirmed. The advantage of this antenna is that bandwidth is increased by switching of PIN diode in the range from 70MHz up to maximum 250MHz. This paper also presents the antenna to operate at frequency range of 3 to 7 GHz of which 5GHz is often used in commercial Wi-Fi applications. These characteristics demonstrate that proposed antenna is an attractive solution for a multimode application like GPS, Wi-Fi Routers, Vehicular communication etc. where wideband is required.

articleTitle: Automated Consolidation of Virtual Machines
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Current Trends in Computer, Electrical, Electronics and Communication (CTCEEC)
abstract: Virtualization of OS is the technology driving all modern data centers. Along with benefits such as reduced costs and easy implementation, virtualization provides the capability to migrate live Virtual Machines (VM) across nodes of a cluster. The existing technology requires manual selection of VMs for live migration which involves redundant migration and hence, not a feasible and efficient solution for large data centers. In this paper, we introduce an automated consolidation technique to reduce the number of active nodes in a cluster. This proposed technique consists of two modules namely consolidation and load balancing which help in achieving the least number of active nodes on the cluster where each VM satisfies Software Licensing Agreement (SLA). This facilitates in achieving quick live migration and node setup while reducing useless migrations which adversely impacts cluster performance. The implementation of the proposed technique has resulted in successful live migration on cluster and consolidation of VMs to minimum number of nodes in the cluster at any given time.
